mapper.sql: q.*, ( select count(1) from ai_text_to_sql_eval_assertion a where a.eval_question_id = q.id ) as assertion_count
mapper.insert: insert into ai_text_to_sql_eval_question( question, business_domain, eval_target, sample_category, source_type, source_run_id, judge_note, remark, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{question}, #{businessDomain}, #{evalTarget}, #{sampleCategory}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRunId}, #{judgeNote}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update ai_text_to_sql_eval_question set question = #{question}, business_domain = #{businessDomain}, eval_target = #{evalTarget}, sample_category = #{sampleCategory}, judge_note = #{judgeNote}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
